name: Valdemorales (Spain)
description: Green field with a white pile issuing from the upper edge to the middle of the lower edge, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Valdemorales (a red saltire between crosses on white).
history: Municipal flag of Valdemorales; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: pile from the upper corners to the middle of the lower edge
